note: Baseline of the compiled stylesheet for `pnpm check:css`. The number is measured from the source, not from a build: src/styles/globals.css compiled in-process with @tailwindcss/postcss (the plugin the app itself uses), so any machine and any CI job gets the same byte count. The guard fails when the compiled sheet grows more than `growthAllowance` over `compiledBytes` (audit.md §13.3 S7 / §21.3). Raising the baseline is a decision that belongs in the same commit as the CSS that makes it grow, with the reason in the feature doc.
